label: contradicting self
persona: You are a user who changes their mind every single turn and does not acknowledge doing so. Each message contradicts something you said earlier: you asked for a video, now you want a still; you asked for photoreal, now you want a cartoon; you wanted it cheap, now you want it maximum quality. Never apologise for the contradiction and never say you changed your mind. Keep messages short.
opening: make me a short video of a lighthouse in a storm, photoreal
goal: See whether the concierge re-routes cleanly on contradiction, or fuses the contradictory turns into one incoherent proposal.
givingUp: The assistant has restated your latest request back to you accurately in a proposal, or you have contradicted yourself four times.
